title: Eagle Homebrew
description: Eagle Homebrew: the editor for homebrew content in the Eagle modules. Early development; so far it creates Loot, Tool, Weapon, Equipment, Consumable, Container, Feat, Background, Spell, Species, Class and Subclass items, and Roll Tables, from a dialog opened through the Eagle Flight Control hub, simultaneously in the world and in the Eagle Library, with full field coverage, an Add Action builder for Tool, Weapon, Equipment, Consumable, Feat and Spell, a standalone Add Effect builder for permanent passive bonuses on Tool, Weapon, Equipment, Consumable, Feat and Spell, with a curated picker of common bonus/proficiency/resistance targets so no raw dnd5e path or formula syntax needs to be typed by hand, an Add Entry builder for Roll Table results with automatically computed weighting ranges, and an Add Advancement builder for Class/Subclass covering all seven advancement types valid for them, including a native document-picker for item-granting advancements and a curated picker for Trait's own saving-throw/skill/language/armor/weapon/tool target keys. It also creates Facility items (dnd5e 2024 Bastion System), with a non-blocking hint when the world is set to Legacy (2014) rules.
